rules.title: Locate by role
rules.text: Locate elements by role, label or text with getByRole and related locators. Avoid long CSS and XPath chains.

rules.title: Web-first assertions
rules.text: Use auto-waiting web-first assertions such as expect(locator).toBeVisible instead of asserting on state read too early.

rules.title: No fixed sleeps
rules.text: Do not use waitForTimeout. Wait for a visible condition instead.

rules.title: Independent tests
rules.text: Keep each test independent, with its own browser context and data, so tests can run in parallel in any order.

rules.title: Traces on first retry
rules.text: Record traces on the first retry and use the trace viewer to debug failures.

rules.title: Retries only in CI
rules.text: Enable retries only in CI, for example retries: process.env.CI ? 2 : 0.

rules.title: Reuse login state
rules.text: Log in once in a setup step and reuse storageState in tests.

rules.title: One project locally
rules.text: Run a single project such as chromium while developing and the full browser matrix in CI.

rules.title: Mock third parties
rules.text: Mock third-party network calls with page.route and keep calls to your own backend real in integration tests.

rules.title: Avoid networkidle
rules.text: Avoid waiting for networkidle. Assert on the UI state that signals readiness.

rules.title: Shared flows
rules.text: Wrap repeated flows in small page objects or helper functions.
